subject: A link for your Helpful Links page
body:
Hi there,

A number of people at TDDC's San Antonio offices receive our referral newsletter, so many of your team already know our program. Your Helpful Links page lists the Crohn's and Colitis Foundation, the American Liver Foundation and others, but nothing for patients whose digestive problems come with obesity, binge eating or a bariatric procedure ahead.

Would you add us to https://tddctx.com/helpful-links/? The page we suggest is our bariatric surgery counseling page, https://www.bariatriccounselingcenter.com/bariatric-surgery-counseling-in-san-antonio-tx/, with the link text "Bariatric surgery counseling in San Antonio, Bariatric Counseling Center".

We are an intensive outpatient program in San Antonio, in network with most health insurance plans, with a virtual option across Texas.

In return we will list TDDC as a referral partner on our website, and we can produce a co-branded printable handout for your patients, "What to expect in the psychological evaluation", with your logo next to ours.

If this belongs with someone in San Antonio rather than communications, please pass it along.

Todd McCord
Bariatric Counseling Center, San Antonio
www.bariatriccounselingcenter.com
